title: LLM-jp-4 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.19331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents LLM-jp-4, a family of Japanese sovereign large language models (LLMs) developed with an emphasis on transparency, reproducibility, and practical usability. LLM-jp-4 comprises an 8B dense model and a 32B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, both trained from scratch on approximately 12 trillion tokens. To support independent verification and reproduction, we establish explicit criteria for selecting training data, external models, and software, and make the development process publicly available. Evaluation results demonstrate substantial improvements over previous LLM-jp models and competitive performance against open-weight models of similar scale. By documenting the development principles, training procedures, and empirical findings of LLM-jp-4, we aim to provide a reference for future sovereign AI development.

translated_abstract: 本文介绍了LLM-jp-4，这是一系列日本主权大语言模型（LLM），其开发强调透明性、可复现性和实用可用性。LLM-jp-4包含一个8B密集模型和一个32B-A3B混合专家模型，两者均在约12万亿个token上从头训练。为支持独立验证和复现，我们为训练数据、外部模型和软件的选择制定了明确标准，并公开了开发流程。评估结果表明，LLM-jp-4相较于之前的LLM-jp模型有显著提升，且与同等规模的开放权重模型相比具有竞争力。通过记录LLM-jp-4的开发原则、训练流程和实证发现，我们旨在为未来的主权AI开发提供参考。
tldr: LLM-jp-4是强调透明性与可复现性的日本主权大语言模型系列，包含8B密集模型和32B-A3B混合专家模型，均在约12万亿token上从头训练，性能较之前模型显著提升。
en_tdlr: LLM-jp-4 is a family of Japanese sovereign LLMs emphasizing transparency and reproducibility, comprising an 8B dense model and a 32B-A3B mixture-of-experts model trained from scratch on ~12 trillion tokens, achieving substantial improvements over previous versions and competitive performance against similar-scale open-weight models.
